title: Built a regulatory knowledge layer proof of concept
summary: I built a proof of concept that turned 24 regulatory files into 10,985 searchable chunks and a 994-node knowledge graph, and made the case for it to leadership.
what_would_have_happened: Regulatory, design, risk and complaint evidence would stay scattered and be gathered by hand for each investigation.
the_call: Normalize the evidence once and reuse it for every investigation draft.
what_i_did: Built the pipeline, documented the extraction, search and graph tools, and turned the result into a short narrative for leaders.
what_changed: In the proof of concept, the corpus regenerated a complete investigation assessment with near-identical coverage to the manual version.
